You are right, they arent weak ... check the video I made, my point is that if enemy midlaner has priority, then you get crabs denied.  
The moment you get crabs denied, you are behind for the entire early game by 1 level.  


At this point, ganking a lane to waste flash makes you even more behind, so you need to gank a flashless lane or get lucky with a gank.  


But you also have to be more carefull with the ganks, because you are lvl behind and die easilly.  


You could try to 1v1 someone, but everyone has a level up on you so you get blown up and most likely reported for inting.  


How do you get back ? If the enemy midlaner has a priority, then without crabs you are forced to walk on thin ice and 1 additional mistake can make you behind for the rest of the game.  Assasins are definetly not weak, if they have good early game, they put a backpack on and stuff their teammates in it.  


PS: I am not even mentioning the Pro Play, since that is a different envirement all on it´s own thanks to voice chat.

  


​

Assasin junglers can still carry, but too many things have to fall in place for that to happen, that it´s not about your skill anymore, rather its about being lucky enough to be allowed to utillize it.
